method: Same production-minified SquadApp/Phaser/core in the self-contained offline review build, opt-in fixture hook. 1280×720, 20s measured after 1s warmup. Three heroes plus Yarn and seven adds (eight-enemy cap), 25×HP fixture, all nine hero skills cycled through real beginCast/advance. Forced overlap measures presentation load, not natural balance. RAF is cadence, CDP task is renderer busy time; synthetic visibilitychange verifies pause/resume, not OS background scheduling.
